title: Kissed Glassy Ukrainian Split Peas Pilaf
description: A rich and nostalgic Ukrainian dish featuring split peas, confit tomato, and a satvik friendly approach, resulting in a glassy jelly texture.
instructions: Rinse the split peas and soak them in water for at least 4 hours.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat and saute the onion until translucent.
Add the garlic and carrot to the pan and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the confit tomato, salt, and pepper to the pan and stir well.
Drain and add the split peas to the pan, stirring to combine with the other ingredients.
Add the water to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 45 minutes or until the peas are tender.
Remove the pan from the heat and let it cool slightly, allowing the mixture to thicken and achieve a glassy texture.
